gates.name: Data provenance
gates.rule: Every input has a source link. Any input without an official or licensed source is rejected.

gates.name: Sample size
gates.rule: Minimum number of graded bets before any conclusion.
gates.threshold: UNVERIFIED - to be set after Q-06

gates.name: Out-of-sample test
gates.rule: Rules frozen before the test period; tested only on games after the freeze date (walk-forward).
gates.threshold: Test period never used for design

gates.name: Closing-line value (CLV)
gates.rule: Strategy price beats the closing line on average.
gates.threshold: UNVERIFIED - to be set after Q-06

gates.name: Luck test
gates.rule: Permutation or bootstrap test: result must be unlikely under a no-skill null at a pre-set level.
gates.threshold: UNVERIFIED - level to be set after Q-06

gates.name: Stability across seasons
gates.rule: Sign of the edge is the same in each season tested.

gates.name: Correlation check (combos)
gates.rule: Parlay and combo prices must use estimated leg correlations, not assumed independence.

gates.name: Cost-adjusted return
gates.rule: Result is measured after the bookmaker margin (vig).

gates.name: Legal and compliance
gates.rule: Bet type and market are permitted for the user and for the bookmaker in the user's jurisdiction. Blocked until Q-03 is resolved.
